data.name: Domain Specialization
data.description: A divine scion selects a domain granted by her deity - this domain becomes the divine scion's chosen specialization in representing her deity. Every time a divine scion casts a domain spell from her specialized domain, she heals damage equal to %1 times the spell's level.|DomainSpecBonus
